::: hero-text
Flower is a Python package and command-line interface (CLI) that takes a
[Data Package's](https://datapackage.org/)
[JSON](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JSON) metadata and generates
structured, human-readable documents from it.

## :sparkles: Key features

-   Create structured and human-friendly documents from a Data Package's
    `datapackage.json` file.
-   Use through the command line for convenience, speed, and automation.
-   Has multiple opinionated built-in styles for the output, but also
    has a very flexible and powerful way to create your own custom
    styles.
-   Display the contents of a `datapackage.json` file in a
    human-friendly way directly in the terminal.

:warning: Flower does not manage rendering, publishing, or deploying the
generated documents. See our
[`template-data-package`](https://template-data-package.seedcase-project.org/)
for a template that includes those additional aspects.
:::

## About the Seedcase Project

Flower is part of the [**Seedcase
Project**](https://seedcase-project.org), which helps research projects
manage and process data in line with the
[FAIR](https://www.go-fair.org/fair-principles/) principles.

This package works as a standalone tool but is also integrated into our
[`template-data-package`](https://template-data-package.seedcase-project.org/)
template, which makes it easier to setup, build, and manage a Data
Package.
:::
